work_item: Notification feature for the hub: at minimum notify on pre-check-in, medical exam expiration, and monthly fee (mensalidade) expiration
review_verdict: APPROVED (2026-07-31) -- independent reviewer confirmed the implementation matches plan.md closely: NH-03/04/05/06/07 trigger logic, idempotency (UniqueConstraint + IntegrityError catch, verified with a real simulated-race test), America/Sao_Paulo day-boundary arithmetic, BalanceService call signature, mark_read student-scoping, rate limiting on all three credential endpoints, no VAPID-private-key leakage, no localStorage credential persistence, no XSS surface, and service-worker scope were all independently verified, not just trusted from self-report. One High finding (deployment blocker): .github/workflows/deploy-k8s.yml did not create the vapid-private-key Kubernetes secret entry nor substitute the real VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY value, which would have broken both the new CronJob and the backend Deployment itself (CreateContainerConfigError) on a real deploy. Root fixed this directly (outside all three specialists' write scopes): added --from-literal=vapid-private-key="${{ secrets.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY }}" to the dojo-secrets creation step, and a sed substitution replacing the change-me-vapid-public-key placeholder with ${{ secrets.VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY }} during the Render/Substitute/Apply step, both in .github/workflows/deploy-k8s.yml. One Low/informational finding (RateLimiter.check_rate_limit's datetime.utcnow() usage) is pre-existing, not introduced by this feature, left untouched. Deterministic gates independently re-run by root (not just agent self-report): backend ruff check/format clean, pytest 505 passed (0 failed, 95% coverage, new files 100%), full Behave suite 73/73 scenarios passed; frontend eslint 0 errors, prettier clean, tsc+vite build clean, jest 84/84 passed; dojo-infra/k8s kustomize build succeeds.
next_action: Committed (1b43f9d, feature/reports), pushed, and PR #43 opened (feature/reports -> develop): https://github.com/gregori/dojo-full/pull/43. VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY/VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY GitHub Actions secrets confirmed added by user before push. Post-PR e2e verification (2026-08-01): both notification_hub.feature Behave scenarios already confirmed passing pre-merge; the Cypress spec (notification-hub.cy.ts) was additionally run live against the real dev stack (dojo-app/docker-compose.yml) and both scenarios pass. Verification surfaced and fixed two environment/CI gaps unrelated to app code correctness: (1) the long-running local dev stack needed its DB migrated (alembic upgrade head) and its backend image rebuilt to pick up the new pywebpush dependency, and its frontend container restarted because Docker Desktop's Windows bind-mount file watcher hadn't picked up the new source files -- all environment sync issues, not code bugs; (2) ci-frontend.yml's e2e job explicitly enumerates its Cypress spec list and did not include notification-hub.cy.ts, so it would not have run in CI despite passing locally -- fixed by adding it to the --spec list. No further action pending on this run beyond normal PR review/merge.
